# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-catalog-docs.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:docs`. -->

A user-invoked workflow with a declared tool allowlist, a mandatory deterministic precondition check as its first action, and evidence it must produce to count as complete. Flags may only narrow its authority.

10 of them. Install one with `npx @youdede/toolkit add <slug> --target <runtime> --scope project`, or read what it refuses first with `npx @youdede/toolkit info <slug>`.


## development

| Slug | What it does | Risk | Runtimes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audit-repository-instructions` | Audit repository and folder instruction files for drift, precedence conflicts, and missing operational boundaries. | low | claude-code |
| `preflight-change-environment` | Collect a deterministic redacted environment snapshot before a repository change begins. | low | claude-code |
| `re-pin-mcp-tools` | Review an observed MCP tool inventory and update source pins only after exact human confirmation. | medium | claude-code |
| `assemble-review-brief` | Assemble a review brief from the real diff: scope, risk notes, and test evidence a reviewer can check line by line. | low | claude-code |
| `audit-release-evidence` | Audit the release evidence chain for the current version and emit a machine-readable verdict report. | low | claude-code |
| `draft-evidenced-plan` | Draft an ordered implementation plan where every step cites the code it touches and the evidence that proves completion. | low | claude-code |
| `verify-claims-against-output` | Re-run declared checks and compare every completion claim against fresh command output before accepting it. | low | claude-code |

## operations

| Slug | What it does | Risk | Runtimes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `diagnose-ci-failure` | Diagnose a failing CI run from supplied logs and repository evidence without mutating workflows or rerunning jobs. | low | claude-code |
| `record-work-checkpoint` | Append a redacted, hash-chained work checkpoint to the session ledger with a verified git anchor. | low | claude-code |
| `verify-session-ledger` | Verify the hash-chained session ledger and report exactly which entries, if any, fail integrity. | low | claude-code |

---

Every row links to an artifact directory under `artifacts/` that carries its full text, its behavioral cases, and its target adapters. The machine-readable index is [catalog/artifacts.json](../../catalog/artifacts.json).
